name: Livestream: Escape from Hotel Izanami + Livestream 2: Escape from Togaezuka Happy Place Collection
summary:
A bundle including the first 2 games in the survival horror series Livestream for the Nintendo Switch: Livestream: Escape from Hotel Izanami and Livestream 2: Escape from Togaezuka.

Livestream: Escape from Hotel Izanami - In this side-scrolling action-adventure game, you'll need to scour the inside of an abandoned hotel, looking for clues to solve the mystery of the hotel and ensure your escape from a mysterious, murderous mascot intent to kill.

Livestream 2: Escape from Togaezuka - Can you escape the horror of being hunted down...? The sequel to the survival horror game "Livestream: Escape from Hotel Izanami" is now available!
